item.title: IndiGo Profits Hit by December Meltdown
item.description: For India’s largest airline, December wasn't so much about lost passengers as it was about the rising cost of running a complex operation at scale in a heavily regulated, rupee-dependent market.

item.title: Airbnb Debate Continues: Who Is STR Innovation Actually For?
item.description: Those invested in the current model aren’t happy when we point out a simple truth: The magic of short-term rentals has been professionalized out of existence.

item.title: New AI Tool Pushes Business Travelers Toward Lower-Emission Trips
item.description: With one million users projected in year one, widespread corporate use could impact airline and business travel competition.

item.title: Air India Faces Record $1.6 Billion Loss: Report
item.description: What happens next at Air India, including leadership decisions and regulatory outcomes, will shape not just the carrier's future, but India’s ambition to build a globally credible aviation champion.

item.title: Scaling Short-Term Rentals Is Harder Than the Industry Admits
item.description: Short-term rentals are no longer a frontier business. Outside of a small group of disciplined operators, the sector has settled into a slow, operational grind that favors local execution over national ambition.

item.title: Middle East Tourism Leads in Growth Since 2019
item.description: Growth may slow down to more modest levels, but the region is becoming a global travel hub for sports, tech, and entertainment.

item.title: Mamdani Bans Hidden Hotel Fees and Credit Card Holds in NYC
item.description: By taking on the issue of credit card holds, NYC is going one step further than the national FTC rule on junk fee disclosure. Small hotel operators will be most affected.

item.title: World Cup Could Help Reverse U.S. Tourism Slide
item.description: Mega sporting events are a big pull for travelers, and could help the U.S. overcome other forces keeping tourists away.

item.title: Skift Megatrends Debate: How Fast Will AI Disrupt Travel?
item.description: A VC and Skift research analyst agreed AI will transform travel distribution. They disagreed on timing — and on whether consumers will trust a machine with their most consequential purchases.

item.title: Capital One Gets Deeper Into Business Travel With $5 Billion Brex Acquisition
item.description: Capital One is ambitiously building out its travel business and tech stack. It also recently acquired Discover, which will add to the mix.
